displayName.zh-CN: 更好的 deepseek harness（codex 风格）

description.zh-CN: 面向 Coding 用户的 DSH 整合包，v3.0.0 基座锁定 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（破坏性更新，预发布）。【已挂载 11 个，全部为上游显式声明适配 0.2.1-rc.2】Codex 风格工作区侧栏与轮次导航（@michengai/dsh-codex-ui 1.1.47）、/review 独立子 Agent 代码审查（@michengai/dsh-code-review 1.0.1）、/simplify Git 范围代码简化（@michengai/dsh-simplify 1.0.1）、只读旁问（@michengai/dsh-btw 1.0.4）、费用与余额计量（dsh-cost-meter 1.9.30）、dsh-pet 桌面宠物（0.3.8：蓝色大肥鱼、97 段透明动画、可多开、可选桌面独立小窗）、上下文可视化仪表盘（dsh-context 0.74.0）、子代理独立选模型（dsh-plugin-subagent-director 0.6.0-beta.2，注意上游为 beta）、多智能体团队协作（@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams 0.1.26）、Git 分支图（@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph 0.4.8）、WorkBuddy 桌面端模型接入（dsh-workbuddy-connect 0.7.9，复用 WorkBuddy App 登录态，未登录时分组自动隐藏；注意上游已在 npm 标记停止维护）。【暂屏蔽 13 个：随包安装但不挂载到 bundle 层】这些插件的上游尚未明确声明适配 0.2.1-rc.2（或已明确不适配），为避免兼容门禁拒装与启动崩溃，本版把它们移出 bundles 并同步禁用其在 overrides/cordis.patch.yml 中的行：dsh-ops 0.3.0、@goodandready/dsh-context-lens 0.1.28、@goodandready/dsh-key-limits 0.2.19、dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 1.2.0、@modusensus/dsh-mneme 0.8.13、@mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard 1.0.8、dsh-computer-use-win 0.2.3、dsh-computer-use（fork 钉 72f390a）、dsh-prompt 0.3.0、@liustack/modlens 3.26.6、dsh-effort-slider 1.3.1、dsh-agent-arena（fork 钉 25e2c55，上游精确钉 0.2.0-rc.2）、@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot（fork 钉 7e88006）。重新启用方式：把插件包名加回 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles，并删除 overrides/cordis.patch.yml 中对应的屏蔽条目。自带 50 个跨 harness 精选 skill（安装时由 home/skills/ 落入 DSH_HOME/skills/），含 ego-lite v2.1.0 的 ego-browser（浏览器自动化 skill 形态投递）。版本沿革：v2.9.0 桌宠换装 dsh-pet、新增 ego-lite ego-browser；v2.8.x 增删 dsh-ops/dsh-inline-figures；v2.7.x 修自修复嵌套 skill 与 computer-use 平台守卫；v2.6.0 引入 Codex 风格 Computer Use；v2.5.0 起整合包自带跨 harness skill；v3.0.0 基座 0.2.0-rc.2 → 0.2.1-rc.2 并做插件筛选挂载（详见 README 与 docs/release-notes-v3.0.0.md）。
description.en-US: A coding-oriented DSH modpack. v3.0.0 pins the host to DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (breaking update, pre-release). [Mounted: 11 plugins, every one of which upstream explicitly declares 0.2.1-rc.2 support] Codex-style workspace sidebar and turn navigation (@michengai/dsh-codex-ui 1.1.47), /review independent code review (@michengai/dsh-code-review 1.0.1), /simplify Git-scoped simplification (@michengai/dsh-simplify 1.0.1), read-only side-ask (@michengai/dsh-btw 1.0.4), cost and balance metering (dsh-cost-meter 1.9.30), the dsh-pet desk pet (0.3.8: a blue big fish with 97 transparent animations, multiple pets, and an optional desktop window), a context dashboard (dsh-context 0.74.0), per-subagent model selection (dsh-plugin-subagent-director 0.6.0-beta.2, note: upstream ships a beta), multi-agent teams (@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams 0.1.26), a Git branch graph (@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph 0.4.8), and WorkBuddy desktop model access (dsh-workbuddy-connect 0.7.9, reusing the WorkBuddy app sign-in; the group hides itself when no sign-in is present — note upstream has deprecated this package on npm). [Shelved: 13 plugins are installed but not mounted] Upstream has not explicitly declared 0.2.1-rc.2 support for these (or explicitly does not support it), so to avoid a peer-gate rejection or a startup crash this release removes them from dsh.profile.bundles and disables their rows in overrides/cordis.patch.yml: dsh-ops 0.3.0, @goodandready/dsh-context-lens 0.1.28, @goodandready/dsh-key-limits 0.2.19, dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 1.2.0, @modusensus/dsh-mneme 0.8.13, @mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard 1.0.8, dsh-computer-use-win 0.2.3, dsh-computer-use (fork pinned 72f390a), dsh-prompt 0.3.0, @liustack/modlens 3.26.6, dsh-effort-slider 1.3.1, dsh-agent-arena (fork pinned 25e2c55; upstream pins 0.2.0-rc.2 exactly), @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot (fork pinned 7e88006). To re-enable one, add its package name back to dsh.profile.bundles and delete the matching shelving entry in overrides/cordis.patch.yml. The pack ships 50 curated cross-harness skills into DSH_HOME/skills/, including ego-lite v2.1.0 ego-browser (delivered as a skill). History: v2.9.0 swapped the desk pet to dsh-pet and added ego-lite; v2.8.x added/removed dsh-ops and dsh-inline-figures; v2.7.x fixed nested skills and added the computer-use platform guard; v2.6.0 introduced Codex-style Computer Use; cross-harness skills ship inside the pack since v2.5.0; v3.0.0 moves the host from 0.2.0-rc.2 to 0.2.1-rc.2 with selective plugin mounting (see README and docs/release-notes-v3.0.0.md).
